title: My friends and I built this tool with Stable Diffusion - you can use it to generate textures for 3D meshes with text prompts. Would love for everyone to try it out and provide any feedback! Link to get started in the comments.
author: PolyhiveHQ

comments.author: PolyhiveHQ
comments.body:
Link to get started [here](https://www.polyhive.ai/ai?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=organic_post&utm_campaign=march_texgen_launch&utm_id=aigamedev&utm_content=shed_shirt_truck)  
Also check out our [Discord](https://discord.gg/WjdJDjHVeD)

comments.author: Dekker3D
comments.body: I got an email about it earlier, and checked it out. I couldn't find any information about pricing. I guess it wasn't *explicitly* limited for free users, but many other features are. So, this is probably going to cost something too, if you use it too much, right? Would be good to actually be upfront about that.

replies.author: PolyhiveHQ
replies.body:
Thanks for trying our tool!

This is a free research preview, our current goal is to improve our UX and performance while ensuring that people who want to make 3D art can start using our tool immediately.
